mostWorthwhile.text: Adding vessels to the deeper tissue was most worthwhile: it explained how living cells in the outer layer get supplies even though that layer has no blood vessels.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the prepared sweat gland was straightforward but less interesting because the result only confirmed the fitting.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the outer skin layer has no blood vessels and receives supplies from below.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless; the named slots and pictures made the fittings clear, although the compatible choices were supplied rather than discovered.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter because putting the skin parts together connected their different jobs, though some fittings were predictable.
